scientific_integrity: The discrete Gabor ambiguity diagonalization and Singer perfect difference sets are established classical tools. New claims are sharp sparse complex-coefficient minimax, complete equality classification and support-q rank cutoff, with all-prime-power proof and independent small-case numerical checks; no external review or independent audit claimed.
scientific_limitations: The optimality is for full linear matrix lifting on complete cyclic time-frequency orbits, not necessarily the minimum support for pure-state-only phase retrieval. Only prime-power q and \(N=q^2+q+1\) are classified; the one-deletion rank statement concerns at most \(q\) nonzero window entries. Earlier implicit consequences of known Weyl spectral formulas and classical Singer designs remain a novelty risk.
title: Sharp sparse Gabor tomography at Singer projective-plane lengths
